module: Flowgraph node "Popup" (default category, once + singleActive): displays an information popup that only the button closes (ui_popup.openPopupEntries, type 'info'). Inputs: flow, "reset" (pulse), "title", "text" (string or translatable table), "buttonText" (default 'ui.scenarios.start.start'). Output: flow, set to true on close. Depends on core_input_bindings and ui_popup.
notes: Showing two popups at once queues them (todo from the code).
_executionStarted is defined twice (the last definition replaces the first and does not reset open/done).

_executionStopped.desc: Closes the popup if open and resets the state.

closeDialogue.desc: Closes the tutorial popup if open.

getPopupId.desc: Returns the unique identifier of the popup (manager, graph, node).

action.desc: Name of the activated button or output pin.

onIntroPopupCareerClosed.desc: Hook: popup closed (id); if it is this node's, sets the output flow to true.

openDialogue.desc: Opens the popup with title, text and button label.

reset.desc: Resets done, open and _active to false.

work.desc: Handles the reset; opens the popup when the input flow is active and it is not already open.
